violations.text: The doors to the outside, located in the the rear and the storage room were observed open at onset of inspection. Doors were closed during time of inspection. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the exterior storage shed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
Salad spinner insert was observed cracked. Equipment to be in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 08/22/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the hot holding units have an accumulation of grease, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026

Shelving fixtures and floors in storage shed have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/29/2026

Employees' clothing was observed stored in the walk-in cooler in a box of bagged lettuce. Exterior of bag of lettuce was cleaned and sanitized. Clothing was removed. Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be used for the orderly storage of employees' clothing and other possessions. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

Food contact surfaces of the produce spinner was observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Equipment was cleaned and sanitized during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/13/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the bar in between bays of 3 bay sink (area cleaned during time of inspection) and the hot plates on hot holding units have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 01/13/2026

Food contact surface of equipment/utensil onion slicer was observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Onions slicer was cleaned and sanitized at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/19/2024

Pickles were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Pickles were moved at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/19/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 09/19/2024
The ice machine was observed leaking at the time of inspection. The pipe was observed to be too short to reach the drain. Per PIC service call has been made. New Violation. Correct By: 09/26/2024
The whopper freezer was observed with an accumulation of ice. Establishment is to run a defrost on unit. New Violation. Correct By: 09/19/2024

The floors throughout the storage area and freezer have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/20/2024
